title: R7-50 official-test evaluation, phase Q (Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, R7-40b selectors)

b_star_source.rule: smallest B in {1, 4, 16, 32} whose uniform-grid 25 % row saves >= 25 % of the 100 % row's median per-item total (vision + select + prefill + 7 decode forwards)

latency_label: latency measured on the pre-fixed profiling workload: R7-40c's timing results of the mapped validation benchmark (gqa_dev for GQA testdev-balanced, chartqa_val for ChartQA test; NVIDIA H100 NVL on nodesumo01, 8 forced decode steps, one nodesumo01 bundle job); every fixed-fraction selector row takes the representative S1 seed-0 unit's latency.  Not re-measured on test and not the test sets' actual mean end-to-end latency (addendum Q2 / Q7)
exposure_statement: Relative to this project: the test splits were never used for selector training, hyperparameters or any selection; every row, checkpoint, operating point and statistic was fixed before the read.

Relative to the host's training data: Qwen2.5-VL's training data is undisclosed, so exposure to GQA / ChartQA train (and possibly val / test) cannot be excluded; stated as such (addendum analysis.exposure).

integrity.rule: first complete record per qid wins; unparseable / incomplete lines dropped and counted
first complete record per qid wins; unparseable / incomplete lines dropped and counted

notes: primary family (Q4, D50-2): S1 − S2, S1 − S3 and S1 − uniform grid × GQA testdev-balanced and ChartQA test = 6 contrasts per point, Holm per point within phase Q; the replication reading across hosts rests on S1 − S2 and S1 − S3 (R7-40c decision 5)

points = R7-40c's basis: L25 / L50 / L75 at Qwen's B* when it has one, otherwise quality at fixed fractions 0.25 / 0.5 / 0.75 and no acceleration claim (OPEN-R740-8); the 0.125 rows are the stress point (reported, never a primary point)
cross-host reading descriptive only: phase L (LLaVA) and phase Q (Qwen) side by side; no pooling, no cross-host test
ChartQA: all 2,500 items pooled are primary; human / augmented secondary (D50-3, unadjusted)
no equivalence / non-inferiority claim (no margin set in advance); no anchor row on test (R7-40c's batch-1 official anchor is a validation-set diagnostic)
